ego_restoration.note: Restoration puts the 3 m ego-dropped boxes back into each vehicle's kept set and into the union. A removed disagreement is one of the recorded 291 that all three vehicles then hit or all three miss. A new disagreement is a region that agreed under the frozen rule and would disagree only after that restoration.

coordinate_transform.method: Official CooperScene rotation applied to stored gt_boxes_ego, compared with stored gt_boxes_world.
